Name.value: List of tenderers excluded from the public procurement procedure

Description.value:
For the purposes Article 62(1)(h) of the PPA (exclusion from the public procurement procedure due to the provision of false data or false declaration), the contracting authority verifies the register published in the Electronic Public Procurement System by the Public Procurement Authority. For the purposes of Article 62 (1) (h) (ha) of the PPA, the contracting authority considers the information included in the register published in the EPPS and the declaration of the economic operator under Article 4 (1b), furthermore, the contracting authority may also apply Article 69 (13) of the PPA to request further information necessary to consider the exclusion.
In terms of Article 62 (1)(j) of the PPA, the existence of the exclusion ground in the given procedure shall be verified by the contracting authority during the procedure; as regards earlier contract award procedures, the contracting authority verifies the register published in the EPPS by the Authority. For the purposes of Article 62 (1)(j)(ja) of the PPA, the contracting authority considers the information included in the register published in the EPPS and the declaration of the economic operator under Article 4 (1b), furthermore, the contracting authority may also apply Article 69 (13) of the PPA to request further information necessary to consider the exclusion.

Name.value: Evidence of relevant supplies or services delivered or performed

Description.value: The above certificate shall be issued by: a) entities qualified as contracting authorities pursuant to Directive 2014/24/EU (Article 5(1)(a)-(c), (e) and (f) of the PPA), (b) if the contracting party is other than the entities pursuant to point (a) herein, such entity - in this case, the declaration of the tenderer or candidate, or any other entity contributing to the certification of suitability is also acceptable.
